name: Andy Nelson
residence: Sublette County (2026 general candidate listing, Pinedale)
occupation: Sublette County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Andy Nelson, listed as Andrew G. Nelson on the official 2026 general candidate listing, is a Sublette County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Douglas J. Vickrey, who is serving through the current term. Official 2026 general results show he received 2,088 votes, first of two seats. No separate public-record account of his private occupation or education was found in the official pages and other public records reviewed for this Profile.
